notes.title: At Light Speed Patch 2.0: A Quantum Leap in Gameplay
notes.notes:
[u][b][h1]Hello Explorers![/h1][/b][/u]
[h3]Get ready to push your platforming skills to the limit as At Light Speed unveils its first major content update with Patch 2.0. This update is packed with new movement abilities, obstacles, level sections, upgraded visuals, and enhancements that will take your space exploration experience to new heights.

Patch 2.0 introduces a wealth of content designed to challenge even the most seasoned players. Whether you’re a speedrunner or a casual explorer, the new features in this update will add depth and excitement to every playthrough. With refined gameplay mechanics and fresh challenges, it’s time to see how fast you can escape the desolation of deep space.[/h3]

[h1][b]Key Features of Patch 2.0:[/b][/h1]
[b]New Abilities:[/b] Master new movement that will change the way you navigate the cosmos.
[b]Challenging Obstacles:[/b] Face off against a variety of new obstacles that will test your reflexes and precision.
[b]Expanded Level Sections:[/b] Discover newly designed areas that will push your platforming skills to the edge.
[b]Visual Upgrades:[/b] Enjoy enhanced graphics and visual effects that make every jump and boost feel more fluid.
[b]Quality of Life Improvements:[/b] Experience smoother gameplay with a host of enhancements and optimizations.
[b]New Achievements:[/b] Nuff said!

[b][h1]Patch Notes [/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Added two new movement abilities[/b] - useable while airborne
[*] [i]Double jump boost ability added[/i] - player jumps midair with 90% effectiveness
[*][i] Anti gravity ability added[/i] - player pauses mid air for .5 seconds
[*] Added massive new obstacles - lasers, so many
[*] Revamped existing level sections in the early and midgame
[*] Added 7 optional checkpoints
[*] Added in game timer
[*] Added hall of fame
[*] Added new UI elements
[*] Added more difficult but more rewarding optional jumps
[*] Added new achievements

[*] Improved player control smoothness and responsiveness
[*] Improved player hitboxes
[*] Improved obstacle hitboxes
[*] Improved coyote jumping
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2 - October 1, 2023
notes.notes:
[b]Patch 1.2[/b]
In this update we wanted to allow more players to enjoy the game. Rough localization has been added along with some midgame flow adjustments. 

[b]Updates[/b]
-Icons added to each button for better readability and multi language adaptation.
-Multi country localization added.
-Gem location adjustments to give better game flow and goal setting.
-Obstacle animation timing in mid game adjusted to allow for faster run times.
-Added more space debris on certain challenging jumps to give more readability to the landing.
-Rare instances of players getting stuck have been fixed. If encountered again, please leave feedback in the bugs community discussion.

[b]Upcoming Changes[/b]
We want the game to feel more alive and will be adding some new hidden objectives and achievements >:). Keep an eye out for teasers.

We will be releasing continuous updates as time goes on and are always open to hearing your ideas and bug finds. Please check out our pinned community discussion to leave feedback!

notes.title: Patch 1.1 - September 22, 2023
notes.notes:
Hello!

In this current update we are covering some minor bug fixes we uncovered post launch.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

-Adjust player hitbox to better represent footing on objects.
-Fixed issue with our wall climb mechanic where some players were seeing the falling animation rather land idle/standing/jumping.
-Adjust object hitboxes to fix rare cases where a player may get stuck.
-Added more parallax effect within first few jumps as players learn the controls.


[b]Upcoming Changes[/b]

-Additional language support.
-Additional UI options.


We will be releasing continuous updates as time goes on and are always open to hearing your ideas and bug finds. Please check out our pinned community discussion to leave feedback!
